$comment: Ground truth for the three work orders that were independently reviewed, hand-read from the reviewers' own reports and from the commits the coordinator made afterwards.

`actioned` means the change was altered in response to that dimension's finding(s) before landing — a blocking finding in practice, whatever priority the reviewer gave it (a P3 the coordinator acts on blocks just as much as a P2).
A dimension that did not run has `ran: false` and no label: that is insufficient evidence, not a negative.
Sources: conversation ids name the reviewer's own conversation in the state store; `fixedIn` names the commit that addressed the finding.

correctness.note: [P3] the precedence comment promises an override the code does not have — the landed commit reverses the iteration order (`composerInputs`) and rewrites the comment, which is a behaviour change, not a comment fix.

architecture.note: [P3] what a handler shows renders as core UI with no boundary and no extension name — the landed commit carries `{ extension, version }` per handler and wraps the shown node in a boundary.

simplicity.note: [P3] the SDK exports two constants nobody uses — the landed commit exports `imageMimeTypes` alone.

correctness.note: [P3] the spill file is truncated when output arrives after `spill.finish()` — not addressed by the follow-up commit; only the shell-call rename reached `server/owned-env.ts`.

architecture.note: [P2] the finish card is at-most-once (`reported` set before the card) and [P2] a job's log routine is a second copy of automations', plus [P2] the leftover count crossing the boundary through a string literal — all three addressed.

simplicity.note: [P2] the dead-leader adoption branch has no test and [P2] `append` reads and rewrites the whole log per chunk — both addressed, the test added.

correctness.note: [P2] `switchBack` drops the pending return on unsettled login evidence — fixed, and a2fddafa adds the test the review asked for; the [P3] naming the family model is fixed in the same commit.

architecture.note: no architecture reviewer was started for this work order: insufficient evidence, not a negative

simplicity.note: no simplicity reviewer was started for this work order: insufficient evidence, not a negative
